points.why: It says both models are fitted to the same curve and that a flat total fits both stories, so the fit cannot separate them.
It flags inferred churn as a hidden free parameter, but never proposes a link-by-link structure review with sales or support staff or with independent reviewers.
It lists checkable points where the models diverge (gross adds vs churn, cohorts, penetration and support segments, timing) and asks for disconfirming predictions written down beforehand.
It discusses pilots and reversibility but never tests which uncertain parameters would flip the expansion-versus-support decision.

pitfalls.why: It explicitly rejects using historical fit to choose between the models.
